```{r, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4.5)
```

Every figure and table below reads the same journey data contract, uses
the same states dictionary (node order, empty nodes, one colour per
state) and runs the same `dplyr` code on a data frame or a database table.
All data are synthetic (`jn_simulate()`; fictional codes).

```{r setup}
library(sanpo)
ep <- jn_simulate(2000)
j <- jn_sequence(ep, max_steps = 4)
```

## Lines of therapy

`jn_lines()` turns prescription rows into lines of therapy: drugs started
within `window` (28 days) of each other form one regimen, a new line
starts when a drug is added or switched to, and a drug is continuous while
its gaps are at most `grace` (60 days). The defaults are provisional
(see `DECISIONS.md`).

```{r lines}
lt <- jn_lines(ep, drug = "state", max_steps = 3)
lt
head(tbl_pathways(lt), 8)
plot_sankey(lt)
```

## Transition matrix

```{r transition}
head(jn_matrix(j))
plot_transition(j)
plot_transition(j, by_step = TRUE, label = "pct")
```

## Lasagna plot

One strip per patient, sorted by pathway; large cohorts are down-sampled
to `n_max` patients (every k-th patient in pathway order).

```{r lasagna, fig.height = 6}
plot_lasagna(j, n_max = 300, horizon = 730)
```

## Cohort attrition

```{r attrition, fig.height = 5, fig.width = 6}
at <- jn_attrition(ep,
  "Started before 2023" = start < as.Date("2023-01-01"),
  "Drug A to C" = state %in% c("Drug A", "Drug B", "Drug C"),
  "Supply >= 28 days" = end - start >= 27
)
at
plot_attrition(at)
```

## Small cells

Every table goes through one suppression hook, `jn_suppress()`. Set a
project-wide minimum once, for example `options(sanpo.min_cell = 10)`.

```{r suppress}
head(jn_matrix(j, min_cell = 10))
```

## The same code in a database

```{r db, eval = requireNamespace("duckdb", quietly = TRUE) && requireNamespace("dbplyr", quietly = TRUE)}
con <- DBI::dbConnect(duckdb::duckdb())
ep_db <- dplyr::copy_to(con, ep, "episodes")
lt_db <- jn_lines(ep_db, drug = "state", max_steps = 3,
                  drugs = levels(ep$state), engine = "db")
identical(tbl_pathways(lt_db, engine = "db"), tbl_pathways(lt))
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```
